title: GST Invoice Check
description: Stops GST invoices going out under the wrong tax head by comparing the supplier GSTIN's state code with the place of supply to pick CGST + SGST/UTGST or IGST (SEZ and exports always IGST), then checking each rate against the slabs in force on the invoice date (including the 28% slab ending on 1 Feb 2026), zero-rated LUT exports, the CGST/SGST split, every amount and the total, with a one-tap fix.
stops: GST invoice under the wrong tax head
